pr_title: Add local score import from stable
pr_body:
Current issues:
- Replays are deleted from stable
- Clicking the completion notification shows the first imported score, not sure if this is ok

Closes #5065
pr_comments:
This PR should also cover the initial data import dialog, which should state that it can import replays as well.

Also can you explain why "replays are deleted from stable"?

Replay files get deleted because of [this TODO](https://github.com/HoLLy-HaCKeR/osu/blob/HEAD@%7B2019-06-19T18:00:13Z%7D/osu.Game/Database/ArchiveModelManager.cs#L222). The same code gets run whether you import a replay manually or you import them from stable. I'm not sure yet why this doesn't happen for beatmaps or skins, but I assume it's because they're folders so the File.Exists check would fail.

Applied the suggestions, but I'm still not sure on what the best way is to let ArchiveModelManager know whether to remove the imported files or not. Also, I've changed the import button for scores so it mentions that only replays will be imported, not everything in scores.db.
A method such as `virtual bool ShouldRemoveArchive(string archivePath)` may be sufficient, and `BeatmapManager` would do it for paths ending in .osz,

How would it know the difference between imported and manually archives? I imagine that it shouldn't remove archives imported through the import button, but it should remove those that are dragged into the game window. With beatmaps and skins you can just check if they are .osb or .osr files, but replays always have .osr extensions, whether they are in use by stable or not.

BeatmapManager would remove if it's a .osz, but not if it's a directory. ScoreManager would never remove.

Am I missing a case?
Is that the last remaining issue to bring this out of draft?
I figured ScoreManager would remove manually imported scores, but that works too. I'll add that and mark it ready for review.
I've tidied up and reverted some of the changes you made. Please check to see how things should have been done.

issue_context.title: Add a "Import Local Plays From Stable" button
issue_context.body:
**Describe the new feature:** 
In the Settings, there is an "Import beatmaps from stable"(which imports all [new] beatmaps from stable) button and an "Import skins from stable"(which imports all skins from stable) button. In addition to this, I would also appreciate a "Import Local Plays from stable" button which imports all local plays from stable so the play history and other stuff is also recovered instead of just skins and beatmaps.

**Proposal designs of the feature:** 
At the first Lazer startup, add a question at also asks if the user wants to import beatmap history. Also add 2 buttons in Settings below the "Delete ALL skins" button that say "Import beatmap history from stable" and "Delete ALL beatmap history" which do exactly as they say they do on click.
![osu_2019-06-19_10-05-12](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32044067/59737060-cd070c00-9279-11e9-8427-38b231bb2215.jpg)
comments: This should be a 15 minute change. Only special part to consider is that beatmaps should be imported first (before the score import starts) as scores currently exist without a beatmap, I believe.
Wait, does osu!stable delete beatmap play history when you delete a beatmap?

review_comments: For now I think it's fine.
